## Confirmed broader (2026-10-16)
wm_page.create has the same defect: pages created with type pattern (patterns/absolute-bm25-thresholds-need-raw-scores) and type decision (decisions/heuristic-decision-answering-as-peer-answerer) were written as FLAT PROSE (no schema_version/state/questions/answers), and wm_validate returned status pass for both. So the gap is not wm_doc-specific — it is the record-envelope build path on create for record-bearing types.
Repro: wm_page.create({action:create, path:'decisions/<x>', type:'decision', content:'## Context\n...'}) -> file body starts '## Context', no envelope; wm_validate.check({entity:'wiki:decisions/<x>'}) -> pass.
